result.title: MAPES: Multi-Value Alignment Pipeline via Expert Specialization
result.summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences requires simultaneously satisfying multiple, often competing values. Existing preference optimization methods collapse these into a single implicit signal, and even multi-objective extensions optimize within a shared parameter space, leaving cross-value conflicts unresolved. We propose MAPES, a multi-value alignment paradigm in which conflict resolution is a first-class concern at every pipeline stage: it first decomposes supervision into value-specific experts trained in isolated parameter subspaces, then recomposes them via preference-aware value merging and a lightweight harmonization stage that aligns the merged model with the expert ensemble. Across five preference alignment benchmarks, MAPES outperforms strong direct preference optimization (DPO) variants and multi-objective baselines on the benchmark-level average, with no large degradation on GSM8K and GPQA; matched controls isolate the contribution of each stage.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 MAPES，通过将监督信号分解为参数隔离的价值特定专家，再经偏好感知合并与轻量协调阶段，实现多价值对齐。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作聚焦 LLM 多价值偏好对齐与参数子空间合并，未涉及视觉或多模态推理中的 latent 状态、证据使用或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系，也未给出可核查的借鉴线索。
